title: MAGVIT
notes: Official JAX source; repository archived/read-only. Model weights were not approved for release: https://github.com/google-research/magvit/issues/16 . Project page is a results gallery, not public inference.

title: MAGVIT-v2
notes: No first-party MAGVIT-v2-specific code, weights, or inference demo identified. google-research/magvit is official-related MAGVIT v1 code, not v2 code. Open-MAGVIT2 and O2-MAGVIT2 are third-party. Publication record: https://research.google/pubs/language-model-beats-diffusion-tokenizer-is-key-to-visual-generation/

title: VideoPoet
notes: Official project is a curated-results presentation, not open inference. No official code or weights identified. Google article: https://research.google/blog/videopoet-a-large-language-model-for-zero-shot-video-generation/

title: DDPM
notes: Original author TensorFlow 1.15 implementation; repository directly links this Models and samples archive.

title: Latent Diffusion Models
notes: Official CompVis repository, representative text-to-image checkpoint, and official Space; the model zoo contains additional task-specific checkpoints.

title: Video Diffusion Models
notes: Author project/gallery only. No first-party code, checkpoint, or inference service identified; community PyTorch recreations are excluded.

title: Make-A-Video
notes: Meta project/gallery only; a possible-future-access form was not public inference. No official code or weights. Announcement: https://ai.meta.com/blog/generative-ai-text-to-video/

title: Imagen Video
notes: Official page explicitly says model and source code were not released. It is a results gallery, not public inference.

title: Rectified Flow / Flow Matching
notes: Flow Matching paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.02747 . Code field is the original authors' official Rectified Flow implementation. Original Flow Matching author Yaron Lipman's later official Meta library is https://github.com/facebookresearch/flow_matching and releases no pretrained models.

title: Diffusion Transformer
notes: Author-linked official Meta repository and checkpoint. Repository archived/read-only under CC-BY-NC; official author Space was in runtime-error state when audited.

title: Latent Video Diffusion
notes: Original NVIDIA/LMU Video LDM project/gallery only; no official code, checkpoint, or hosted inference identified. Do not substitute Stable Video Diffusion or community recreations.

title: AnimateDiff
notes: Official author source and pretrained motion modules. README-linked Colabs are community-hosted, so no official demo is claimed.

title: Stable Video Diffusion
notes: Official Stability inference code and downloadable weights. Hosted SVD API was deprecated 2025-07-24: https://kb.stability.ai/knowledge-base/how-to-access-stable-video-diffusion

title: W.A.L.T.
notes: Google/Stanford author results gallery only; no official code, weights, or inference service identified. Publication record: https://research.google/pubs/photorealistic-video-generation-with-diffusion-models/

title: VideoCrafter1 / VideoCrafter2
notes: VideoCrafter2 report: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09047 . Official V1 project: https://ailab-cvc.github.io/videocrafter1/ . Official weight collection: https://huggingface.co/VideoCrafter/models . Official Space was in build-error state when audited; repository includes local Gradio.

title: Lumiere
notes: Author project/gallery only; no official Google code, weights, or inference endpoint. Public kyegomez/lucidrains repositories are third-party recreations.

title: Sora (2024 original)
notes: Closed OpenAI model with no published source or weights. Original Sora product is unavailable as of 2026-04-26 per the official page; Sora 2 is a distinct model/product.

title: CogVideoX
notes: Former THUDM URLs redirect to official Z.ai. Repository, model, and Space are first-party. CogVideoX-2B is Apache-2.0; 5B uses the CogVideoX model license.

title: Movie Gen
notes: Meta report and first-party galleries only; no public code, checkpoints, or inference service. Publication record: https://ai.meta.com/research/publications/movie-gen-a-cast-of-media-foundation-models/

title: HunyuanVideo
notes: Official Tencent source, sampling code, weights, and local Gradio. Weights use Tencent Hunyuan Community License, not a standard OSI license. No stable, clearly first-party hosted inference URL identified.

title: Wan 2.1
notes: First-party Wan project, repository, Wan-AI model, and Wan-AI Space; official repository also links the organization's ModelScope collection.

title: World Models
notes: Author interactive article contains browser demonstrations and links author experiment code; project page legitimately doubles as demo. No separate official weight package identified.

title: PlaNet
notes: Official Google Research implementation, now archived/read-only. No official pretrained weights or hosted demo identified.

title: Dreamer
notes: Original implementation maintained by first author Danijar Hafner. No separate first-party weight distribution or public inference demo identified.

title: MuZero
notes: Code link is paper author Julian Schrittwieser's DeepMind-copyrighted pseudocode, not a complete runnable implementation. No full official source or weights. muzero-general is a community implementation and excluded.
